description: The reference site's real Webflow breakpoints. README.md explicitly calls mixing these with Tailwind's own defaults (640/768/1024/1280/1536) 'the single most common source of layout drift' on this project. This design-repo's own responsive contracts always cite these three, never Tailwind defaults.
measuredFrom: README.md:27-28; verified against min-[992px]/min-[768px]/min-[480px] usage throughout src/components/*.jsx and src/index.css

tablet.note: Tailwind's own md: (768px) happens to coincide here and is used interchangeably in source with min-[768px]:.

mobile.note: Below 480px; several components (Automations, hero visuals) scale continuously with vw rather than stepping again here.

1280px.usage: A few sections (Marketing, section-pad-xl) add an extra min-[1280px]: step for their tallest desktop rhythm — verified at tailwind.config.js/src/index.css usage sites (e.g. src/components/Marketing.jsx:23, src/index.css:67,73). Documented as an additional real step, not a Tailwind default being smuggled back in.
